**For B:**
- **Lows (not fixed in code, because any code change would break the sketch match):**
  1. `placeInsertMarker` writes the marker before it clears the range. During an active gesture the stopped text would read the old range until the gesture ends. No current handler does this, and it is documented in doc 240.
  2. A preview of the text just committed, written again in the same handler, now shows as a new preview. Nothing does this today.
  3. `statusSequence` now counts every intermediate commit. For example, playFrom from a stopped text adds 2 where it added 1 before. Screen-reader behaviour is the same.
  4. The reviewer suggested renaming `getStatus` to `getCommittedStatusText`; the task fixes the name, so I left it.
- **Architecture note:** `status-preview-store.ts` now also owns the committed status. Keep it as one store; a later rename-only task (to `status-store.ts`) is an option.
